```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Libraries and data
```{r}
library(fda)
library(funData)
library(MFPCA)
library(tidyverse)
library(landmarkregUtils)

df <-  read.csv("fullTable_continuousSeq.csv")
```

(skipping the curve plotting for now)

Compute FPCA
```{r}
# build a funData object (limiting it to only one of the vowels for simplicity)
funF2 <- df %>% filter(Label == "I") %>%  distinct(subj, seq, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  
  long2irregFunData( id = "fileName", time = "seq", value = "F2Hz") %>% 
    as.funData()

# Compute FPCA
fpca <- PACE(funF2, npc = 2)

```
